## Load packages

```{r loading packages}
packages <- c("here", "dplyr", "glue", "janitor", "DT", "ggplot2", "scales", "stringr")
for (p in packages) {
  if (p %in% rownames(installed.packages())) {
    library(p, character.only = TRUE)
  } else {
    install.packages(p)
    library(p, character.only = TRUE)
  }
}

if (!"rCAX" %in% rownames(installed.packages())) {
  if (!"remotes" %in% rownames(installed.packages())) install.packages("remotes")
  remotes::install_github("nwfsc-cb/rCAX")
}
library(rCAX)

windowsFonts(`Times New Roman` = windowsFont("TT Times New Roman"))
```

## Define data loading and cleaning function

```{r define function}
#Pulls a StreamNet HLI table via rCAX, filtered to a single ESU/DPS.
#Defaults are NOSA (natural-origin spawner abundance) for Upper
#Columbia spring Chinook. pop_label names the saved CSV/figure files
hli_pull_clean <- function(hli_type = "NOSA",
                            esudps_sel = "Salmon, Chinook (Upper Columbia River spring-run ESU)",
                            pop_label = "upper_columbia"){
  cat(glue("loading {hli_type} data for {esudps_sel}\n"))
  
  hli_raw <- rcax_hli(
    hli_type,
    flist = list(esudps = esudps_sel)
  )
  #tsaij/tsaej = total spawner abundance incl./excl. jacks; nosaij/
  #nosaej = natural-origin spawner abundance incl./excl. jacks;
  #phosij = percent hatchery-origin spawners incl. jacks
  hli_clean <- hli_raw %>%
    clean_names() %>%
    mutate(
      tsaij = as.numeric(tsaij),
      tsaej = as.numeric(tsaej),
      nosaij = as.numeric(nosaij),
      nosaej = as.numeric(nosaej),
      phosij = as.numeric(phosij)
    )
  
  cat(glue("pulled {nrow(hli_clean)} rows\n"))
  
  colnames_df <- data.frame(column_name = colnames(hli_clean))
  write.csv(colnames_df, here("Results", "CSV Files", glue("streamnet_nosa_{pop_label}_colnames.csv")), row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(hli_clean, here("Results", "CSV Files", glue("streamnet_nosa_{pop_label}.csv")), row.names = FALSE)
  
  return(hli_clean)
}
```

## Call function for each subset of interest

```{r call function all subsets}

  esudps_sel = "Salmon, Chinook (Upper Columbia River spring-run ESU)",
  pop_label = "upper_columbia"
)

  hli_type = "NOSA",
  esudps_sel = "Steelhead (Upper Columbia River DPS)",
  pop_label = "upper_columbia_steelhead"
)

nosa_snake_spsu <- hli_pull_clean(
  esudps_sel = "Salmon, Chinook (Snake River spring/summer-run ESU)",
  pop_label = "snake_spring_summer"
)

#Not one of the four core target subsets, kept for the write-up
nosa_snake_fall <- hli_pull_clean(
  esudps_sel = "Salmon, Chinook (Snake River fall-run ESU)",
  pop_label = "snake_fall"
)

nosa_snake_steelhead <- hli_pull_clean(

)
```

## Explore additional data issues, produce summaries, and visualize

```{r define presentation theme and export function}
presentation_theme <- theme(
  text = element_text(family = "Times New Roman", face = "bold", size = 22),
  plot.title = element_text(size = 28, face = "bold"),
  axis.title = element_text(size = 22),
  axis.text = element_text(size = 18),
  strip.text = element_text(size = 18),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 18),
  legend.title = element_text(size = 20)
)

ggsave_presentation <- function(filename, height = 7.5, width = 13.33, dpi = 300){
  ggsave(here("Results", "Figures", filename), height = height, width = width, dpi = dpi)
}

wrap_title <- function(text, width = 28){
  paste(strwrap(text, width = width), collapse = "\n")
}

#Splits populationname into location_name and run_species. Most names
#use " - " as a separator; some have no dash and instead end in a
#run/species phrase, which is matched and stripped separately
split_pop_name <- function(df){
  split_cols <- stringr::str_split_fixed(df$populationname, " - ", n = 2)
  
  location_name <- split_cols[, 1]
  run_species <- split_cols[, 2]
  
  run_species_patterns <- c(
    "spring Chinook Salmon", "summer Chinook Salmon", "fall Chinook Salmon",
    "spring/summer Chinook Salmon", "summer Steelhead", "spring Steelhead"
  )
  
  no_dash <- run_species == ""
  
  for (pattern in run_species_patterns) {
    matches <- no_dash & endsWith(location_name, paste0(" ", pattern))
    run_species[matches] <- pattern
    location_name[matches] <- trimws(sub(paste0(" ", pattern, "$"), "", location_name[matches]))
  }
  
  df %>%
    mutate(
      location_name = location_name,
      run_species = run_species
    )
}
```

```{r define exploration and visualization functions}
#Missingness summary and preview of a cleaned NOSA dataframe
show_missingness_summary <- function(df){
  df %>% count(populationname) %>% print()
  
  print(datatable(df))
  
  na_summary <- data.frame(
    column_name = colnames(df),
    n_missing = colSums(is.na(df))
  )
  datatable(na_summary)
}

#Data coverage timeline: blue = tsaij present, dark red = row exists
#but tsaij is NA, light red = no row at all for that population/year.
#Filtered to bestvalue == "Yes" so duplicate agency rows don't appear
#as separate coverage entries for the same population/year
show_coverage_by_population <- function(df, pop_label = "upper_columbia", title_label = "Upper Columbia"){
  pop_data <- df %>%
    filter(bestvalue == "Yes") %>%
    filter(!is.na(spawningyear)) %>%
    split_pop_name() %>%
    select(location_name, spawningyear, tsaij)
  
  year_range <- seq(min(pop_data$spawningyear), max(pop_data$spawningyear))
  populations <- unique(pop_data$location_name)
  
  full_grid <- data.frame()
  for (pop in populations) {
    full_grid <- bind_rows(full_grid, data.frame(location_name = pop, spawningyear = year_range))
  }
  
  pop_data_summary <- pop_data %>%
    group_by(location_name, spawningyear) %>%
    summarize(has_row = TRUE, has_value = any(!is.na(tsaij)), .groups = "drop")
  
  data_status <- full_grid %>%
    left_join(pop_data_summary, by = c("location_name", "spawningyear")) %>%
    mutate(
      status = case_when(
        is.na(has_row) ~ "No data reported",
        has_value ~ "Data available",
        TRUE ~ "NA"
      )
    )
  
  plot_title <- wrap_title(glue("NOSA Data Availability by Population ({title_label})"))
  
  data_status %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = spawningyear, y = location_name, fill = status)) +
    geom_tile(height = 0.9, width = 1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
      "Data available" = "blue",
      "NA" = "darkred",
      "No data reported" = "lightcoral"
    )) +
    labs(title = plot_title, x = "Year", y = NULL, fill = "Status") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
    presentation_theme +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 22))
  
  ggsave_presentation(glue("nosa_data_av_by_pop_{pop_label}.png"))
}

#Same coverage logic as above, shown per metric (TSAIJ, TSAEJ, NOSAIJ,
#NOSAEJ), checked separately for each. Filtered to bestvalue == "Yes"
#for the same reason as show_coverage_by_population
show_coverage_all_metrics <- function(df, pop_label = "upper_columbia", title_label = "Upper Columbia"){
  df_split <- df %>% filter(bestvalue == "Yes") %>% split_pop_name()
  
  df_long <- bind_rows(
    df_split %>% mutate(metric = "TSAIJ", group_label = paste(location_name, "- TSAIJ"), metric_value = tsaij),
    df_split %>% mutate(metric = "TSAEJ", group_label = paste(location_name, "- TSAEJ"), metric_value = tsaej),
    df_split %>% mutate(metric = "NOSAIJ", group_label = paste(location_name, "- NOSAIJ"), metric_value = nosaij),
    df_split %>% mutate(metric = "NOSAEJ", group_label = paste(location_name, "- NOSAEJ"), metric_value = nosaej)
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(spawningyear)) %>%
    select(group_label, spawningyear, metric_value)
  
  year_range <- seq(min(df_long$spawningyear), max(df_long$spawningyear))
  group_labels <- unique(df_long$group_label)
  
  full_grid <- data.frame()
  for (g in group_labels) {
    full_grid <- bind_rows(full_grid, data.frame(group_label = g, spawningyear = year_range))
  }
  
  group_data_summary <- df_long %>%
    group_by(group_label, spawningyear) %>%
    summarize(has_row = TRUE, has_value = any(!is.na(metric_value)), .groups = "drop")
  
  data_status <- full_grid %>%
    left_join(group_data_summary, by = c("group_label", "spawningyear")) %>%
    mutate(
      status = case_when(
        is.na(has_row) ~ "No data reported",
        has_value ~ "Data available",
        TRUE ~ "NA"
      )
    )
  
  plot_title <- wrap_title(glue("NOSA Data Availability by Population and Metric ({title_label})"))
  
  data_status %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = spawningyear, y = group_label, fill = status)) +
    geom_tile(height = 0.9, width = 1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
      "Data available" = "blue",
      "NA" = "darkred",
      "No data reported" = "lightcoral"
    )) +
    labs(title = plot_title, x = "Year", y = NULL, fill = "Status") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
    presentation_theme +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 22))
  
  ggsave_presentation(glue("nosa_data_av_by_pop_metric_{pop_label}.png"))
}

#Total vs. natural-origin spawner abundance (including jacks), faceted
#by population. Blue = total, red = natural-origin. Filtered to
#bestvalue == "Yes" so duplicate agency rows don't create extra
#overlapping lines/points for the same population/year
show_total_vs_natural_plot <- function(df, pop_label = "upper_columbia", title_label = "Upper Columbia"){
  p <- df %>%
    filter(bestvalue == "Yes") %>%
    split_pop_name() %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = spawningyear)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = tsaij, linetype = "Total (TSAIJ)"), linewidth = 1, color = "blue") +
    geom_point(aes(y = tsaij), size = 3, color = "blue") +
    geom_line(aes(y = nosaij, linetype = "Natural-origin (NOSAIJ)"), linewidth = 1, color = "red") +
    geom_point(aes(y = nosaij), size = 3, color = "red") +
    facet_wrap(~ location_name, ncol = 2) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
    labs(title = glue("Total vs. Natural-Origin Spawner Abundance (Including Jacks)\nby Population and Year ({title_label})"),
         x = "Year", y = "Spawner Abundance",
         linetype = "Metric") +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
    presentation_theme +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 13))
  
  ggsave_presentation(glue("nosa_totspabund_ij_by_pop_{pop_label}.png"))
  print(p)
}

#Same as above, excluding jacks
show_total_vs_natural_ej_plot <- function(df, pop_label = "upper_columbia", title_label = "Upper Columbia"){
  p <- df %>%
    filter(bestvalue == "Yes") %>%
    split_pop_name() %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = spawningyear)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = tsaej, linetype = "Total (TSAEJ)"), linewidth = 1, color = "blue") +
    geom_point(aes(y = tsaej), size = 3, color = "blue") +
    geom_line(aes(y = nosaej, linetype = "Natural-origin (NOSAEJ)"), linewidth = 1, color = "red") +
    geom_point(aes(y = nosaej), size = 3, color = "red") +
    facet_wrap(~ location_name, ncol = 2) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
    labs(title = glue("Total vs. Natural-Origin Spawner Abundance (Excluding Jacks)\nby Population and Year ({title_label})"),
         x = "Year", y = "Spawner Abundance",
         linetype = "Metric") +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
    presentation_theme +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 13))
  
  ggsave_presentation(glue("nosa_totspabund_ej_by_pop_{pop_label}.png"))
  print(p)
}

#Percent hatchery-origin spawners (phosij) by population and year.
#Filtered to bestvalue == "Yes" for the same reason as the other plots
show_hatchery_origin_pct_plot <- function(df, pop_label = "upper_columbia", title_label = "Upper Columbia"){
  p <- df %>%
    filter(bestvalue == "Yes", !is.na(phosij)) %>%
    split_pop_name() %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = spawningyear, y = phosij)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1, color = "blue") +
    geom_point(size = 3, color = "blue") +
    facet_wrap(~ location_name, ncol = 2) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(title = glue("Percent Hatchery-Origin Spawners\nby Population and Year ({title_label})"),
         x = "Year", y = "Percent Hatchery-Origin") +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    presentation_theme +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 13))
  
  ggsave_presentation(glue("nosa_hatchery_origin_pct_by_pop_{pop_label}.png"))
  print(p)
}
```

```{r Snake River NOSA by population, fig.height = 7.5, fig.width = 13.33}
#Combines spring/summer-run and fall-run into one dataset, with a
#run_type column so facets stay distinct. Filtered to bestvalue == "Yes"
#so duplicate agency rows aren't double-summed in the group_by/summarize
snake_nosa_combined <- bind_rows(
  nosa_snake_spsu %>% filter(bestvalue == "Yes") %>% split_pop_name() %>% select(location_name, spawningyear, tsaij) %>% mutate(run_type = "Spring/Summer-Run"),
  nosa_snake_fall %>% filter(bestvalue == "Yes") %>% split_pop_name() %>% select(location_name, spawningyear, tsaij) %>% mutate(run_type = "Fall-Run")
) %>%
  mutate(facet_label = paste(location_name, "-", run_type))

snake_nosa_combined %>%
  group_by(spawningyear, facet_label) %>%
  summarize(total_spawners = sum(tsaij, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = spawningyear, y = total_spawners, color = facet_label)) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_wrap(~ facet_label, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(title = "Total Spawner Abundance (Including Jacks)\nby Population and Year (Snake River, All Runs)",
       x = "Year", y = "Total Spawner Abundance") +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  presentation_theme +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 13))

ggsave_presentation("nosa_snake_by_pop_year_all_runs.png")
```

```{r Upper Columbia NOSA by population, fig.height = 7.5, fig.width = 13.33}
nosa_upper_columbia %>%
  filter(bestvalue == "Yes") %>%
  split_pop_name() %>%
  group_by(spawningyear, location_name) %>%
  summarize(total_spawners = sum(tsaij, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = spawningyear, y = total_spawners, color = location_name)) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_wrap(~ location_name, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(title = "Total Spawner Abundance (Including Jacks)\nby Population and Year (Upper Columbia)",
       x = "Year", y = "Total Spawner Abundance") +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  presentation_theme +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 13))

ggsave_presentation("nosa_upper_columbia_by_pop_year.png")
```
